rationale: The short thesis remains intact as EZPW continues to trade near the bottom of its daily range (5.6%) on high relative volume (3.25x) in a weak broad market (SPY -2.08%). Although price bounced modestly off the $24.20 low to reach a high of $24.32, it has since ticked back down to $24.25 and remains well below the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($24.41), VWAP ($24.59), and our $24.48 invalidation level. With the bid sitting directly at the $24.20 session low and a wide 37.1 bps spread ($24.20 x $24.29), holding for a clean breakdown continuation is preferable to exiting early into spread friction.
